summary: Dingdong (Cayman) Limited filed its Q2 2026 earnings on Form 6-K, revealing an ongoing definitive agreement dated February 5, 2026, to divest its China business to Meituan (HKEX: 3690). The transaction remains pending, contingent on standard closing conditions, notably SAMR anti-monopoly approval. The China business is classified as held-for-sale, with no depreciation/amortization recognized, boosting net income by RMB199.1 million (US$29.3 million) in Q2. No financial terms were disclosed. Watch for SAMR approval timing and any regulatory conditions that could affect deal completion.
